assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
To correlate these symptomatic events with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances, a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is medically necessary for ambulatory evaluation.
The diagnosis codes I47.1 and R55 support the symptomatic events being evaluated by this service.
